# Chiasm <version> experimental preview

Chiasm is a spatial-first experiment in exploring a music collection. This is a separate project derived from the Melodex codebase.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS — Apple Silicon | `Chiasm-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS — Intel | `Chiasm-macOS-intel.dmg` |
| Windows installer | `Chiasm-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Windows portable | `Chiasm-Windows-portable.zip` |
| Android companion | `Chiasm-Android.apk` and `Chiasm-Android.aab` |
| Source | `Chiasm-v<version>-source.zip` |

## Preview notes

Chiasm remains experimental. Report spatial interaction, collection exploration, accessibility, and performance issues through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/DasManPack/chiasm/issues).

The Android package is currently a bridge companion for a Chiasm desktop host. macOS packages are not notarized. Chiasm-specific work is MIT-licensed; inherited Melodex code and third-party materials retain their original notices and licences.
